prompt: Implement a modular Enterprise Log Ingestion and Analytics Pipeline in C# featuring three subsystems: (1) High-Throughput Log Collector using producer-consumer BlockingCollection queues, (2) Real-Time Pattern Matcher utilizing compiled Regular Expressions and anomaly sliding windows, and (3) Persistent Indexing Subsystem writing compressed log chunks to disk with thread-safe file locking. Provide fully realized class hierarchies.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Collector Score: 0-5 (Evaluates thread-safe producer-consumer queue implementation)
Module 2 Matcher Score: 0-5 (Evaluates regex performance and sliding window anomaly logic)
Module 3 Storage Score: 0-5 (Evaluates buffered disk writing and file lock safety)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates end-to-end data pipeline flow and exception isolation)
